name: purchase-to-stock-v1
invariants: all resources are read back in the selected tenant
purchase order item is server-generated and belongs to the selected product
receipt item references the server-generated order item and selected warehouse
receipt draft changes order inCount but does not change stock
receipt approval increases stock by exactly the receipt quantity
exactly one biz_type=70 stock movement matches receipt id, item id, quantity and after quantity
cleanup creates the compensating biz_type=71 movement and restores baseline stock
